# Heading — Local-Only Test Reds: Gitignored Demo Data + Order-Dependent Build-Info Flake

**Class:** `gitignored-demo-data-local-only-test-failure`

## Root Cause Analysis

**Failure A — gitignored demo data leaks into explanations**
- `packages/crm/data/bookings.json` is **gitignored**, so it exists locally but not on CI.
- It held a Sep 29 `client-al-rashid-family` export with **6 CDG–JFK demo bookings**.
- The CRM runtime feeds those into learned-preferences text, producing:
  `Learned: matches your 6 previous CDG-JFK bookings, decayed weight 0.97`
  and flipping the path to `All primary preferences satisfied`.
- Negative assertions forbid those strings → red **only** where the file exists. CI lacks it → green.

**Failure B — order-dependent generated build-info**
- Stale `build-info.generated` gives a `SyntaxError` in full-suite runs only; 5/5 green in isolation. Classified as a flake, not a regression (per the pitfall).

## Diagnosis Ladder
```bash
grep -rn "All primary preferences satisfied" packages/crm/src packages/crm/test
grep -rn "Learned: matches your" packages/crm/src
git check-ignore -v packages/crm/data/bookings.json   # ignored => CI-absent
jq 'length' packages/crm/data/bookings.json
pnpm --filter @heading/api test -- --run auth-boot-prereqs   # isolation check
```

## Exact Fix
```bash
# A) Timestamped quarantine of the untracked data (never delete tracked files)
ts="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; mkdir -p "/tmp/heading-quarantine/$ts"
mv packages/crm/data/bookings.json "/tmp/heading-quarantine/$ts/bookings.json"

# B) Durable: committed fixture + redirect loader
mkdir -p packages/crm/test/fixtures
printf '[]\n' > packages/crm/test/fixtures/bookings.empty.json
git add packages/crm/test/fixtures/bookings.empty.json
```
```ts
process.env.CRM_DATA_DIR = new URL('./fixtures', import.meta.url).pathname;
```
```ts
// loader seam
const dataDir = process.env.CRM_DATA_DIR ?? new URL('../../data', import.meta.url).pathname;
```
```bash
# C) Stabilize build-info
rm -f packages/*/build-info.generated* packages/*/src/build-info.generated*
pnpm -w build
```
Document the LOCAL-vs-CI baseline rule in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (gitignored inputs are never assumed present on CI; full-run-only reds must be rerun in isolation first).

## Verification
| Check | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Full suite | 708 passed / 3 failed | 99 files, 708 tests — ALL PASS |
| Coverage gates | failing | met |
| Gitignored demo data | present locally | quarantined (`/tmp` backup) |
| Pre-fix red-proof | — | identical 3 reds reproduced |
| Auth/build-info flake | intermittent | 5/5 pass isolated ⇒ flake |

**Verdict:** ambient gitignored runtime data (plus a stale generated artifact) — quarantine the untracked file, migrate tests to committed fixtures, harden artifact generation, enforce baseline discipline. Full details are in the written file.
